Asthma maintenance treatment: 1

Choose the single best answer, then reveal the explanation.

An adult with confirmed asthma uses only a short-acting bronchodilator whenever symptoms occur. At review, the clinician explains that symptom relief alone does not adequately address exacerbation risk. Which broad treatment component should the regimen contain?

  1. An individualized written asthma action plan
  2. An inhaled corticosteroid-containing regimen
  3. Low-dose ICS-formoterol reliever in the preferred adult Track 1 pathway
  4. The same suitable ICS-formoterol inhaler for maintenance and relief
  5. Check diagnosis, inhaler technique, adherence and exposures before stepping up
Reveal answer and explanation
Correct answer

An inhaled corticosteroid-containing regimen

Anti-inflammatory treatment reduces exacerbation risk; SABA-only treatment is not recommended for adults with asthma.

Understanding the options

An inhaled corticosteroid-containing regimen
Anti-inflammatory treatment reduces exacerbation risk; SABA-only treatment is not recommended for adults with asthma.
Low-dose ICS-formoterol reliever in the preferred adult Track 1 pathway
GINA Track 1 uses an anti-inflammatory reliever; the maintenance component depends on the treatment step. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
The same suitable ICS-formoterol inhaler for maintenance and relief
MART combines scheduled maintenance with as-needed doses of a suitable ICS-formoterol product; it does not apply to every ICS-LABA inhaler. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
Check diagnosis, inhaler technique, adherence and exposures before stepping up
Correctable delivery and adherence problems may explain poor control without requiring an automatic dose increase. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
An individualized written asthma action plan
A written plan explains usual treatment, recognition of deterioration, agreed medication changes and when to seek urgent help. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
